mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport compression codec. The stated reason is that zstd compresses better than the alternative and decompresses much faster on both ends of the connection.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md
